svg.title: Theoretical Self Replication, based on the GARDEN Project
svg.desc: The observed lineage was seed, child and grandchild on one host, managed by a trusted controller. The conceptual cross-computer scenario involves a hypothetical vulnerability and has not been demonstrated.

g.text: A bounded lineage on one Windows host
TRUSTED HOST CONTROLLER / MANAGED VIRTUAL MACHINES
Agents requested descendants under a fixed rule; the trusted host provisioned them.
Three replicas total, at most two VMs active at once. The model did not choose whether to reproduce.
A conceptual framework for replication across computers
Concept only: a hypothetical vulnerability could enable replication between systems.
